# hevo_pipelines (Data Source)

Lists the team's Pipelines, optionally filtered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every running Pipeline that loads into one Destination.
data "hevo_pipelines" "into_snowflake" {
  destination_id = hevo_destination.snowflake.id
  states         = ["Initialized"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `destination_id` (String) Keep only Pipelines that load into this Destination.
- `source_connector_id` (String) Keep only Pipelines whose Source uses this connector.
- `states` (List of String) Keep only Pipelines in these states, for example `["Initialized", "Disabled"]`.

### Read-Only

- `pipelines` (Attributes List) The Pipelines. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pipelines))

<a id="nestedatt--pipelines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pipelines`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the Pipeline was created, in RFC 3339.
- `created_by` (String) Who created the Pipeline.
- `destination_id` (String) The id of the Destination the Pipeline loads into.
- `destination_prefix` (String) The prefix of the tables the Pipeline creates.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the Pipeline is paused.
- `frequency_minutes` (Number) How often a `SCHEDULED` Pipeline ingests.
- `health` (String) The Pipeline's health, for example `HEALTHY`.
- `id` (String) The Pipeline's id.
- `load_mode` (String) `MERGE`, `APPEND` or `HISTORY_TRACKING`.
- `name` (String) The Pipeline's display name.
- `replication_type` (String) `HISTORICAL_AND_INCREMENTAL` or `INCREMENTAL_ONLY`.
- `schema_evolution` (String) `ALLOW_ALL`, `BLOCK_ALL` or `ALLOW_COLUMN_LEVEL`.
- `source_connector_id` (String) The source connector, for example `hubspot`.
- `source_name` (String) The Source's display name.
- `source_type` (String) The source type, for example `HUBSPOT`.
- `state` (String) The Pipeline's state, for example `Initialized` or `Disabled`.
- `sync_type` (String) The schedule: `SCHEDULED` or `ON_DEMAND`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the Pipeline was last changed, in RFC 3339.
- `updated_by` (String) Who last changed the Pipeline.
